text: 【假期要闻汇总】中美达成八点成果共识；外交部发言人就人工智能问题答记者问；美财长称中美已同意将贸易休战协议延长至明年1月，外交部回应；央行称综合运用并适时调整货币政策工具，保持流动性充裕；美媒称特朗普拒绝伊朗七日内重开霍尔木兹海峡提议；美国ITC正式对动态随机存取存储器设备及其下游产品和组件启动337调查。
text_en: Holiday news roundup: China and the US reached an eight-point consensus on outcomes; the Foreign Ministry spokesperson answered questions on artificial intelligence; the US Treasury Secretary said China and the US have agreed to extend the trade truce agreement to January next year, and the Foreign Ministry responded; the PBOC said it will comprehensively use and adjust monetary policy tools as appropriate to keep liquidity ample; US media said Trump rejected Iran's proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within seven days; the US ITC formally launched a Section 337 investigation into dynamic random access memory devices and downstream products and components.
